intro: Portuguese is spoken by more than 250 million people worldwide, most of them in Brazil, and Portuguese communities live across the globe.

chapters.title: People and language
text: Lisbon and Porto are the two largest cities. Portuguese is the official language, and Mirandese is recognised in a corner of the north-east. Many Portuguese have emigrated to France, Switzerland, Luxembourg, the United States and Brazil, while newcomers arrive from Brazil, Angola, Cape Verde and South Asia.
Most Portuguese are Catholic, and the shrine of Fátima draws huge pilgrimages. Saudade, a deep longing for something or someone missing, is often called the most Portuguese of feelings.

chapters.title: Daily life
text: Coffee is drunk strong and short, and families gather for long weekend lunches. In June, cities celebrate their patron saints with street parties, sardines and music.

keyTerms.meaning: A Portuguese word for a deep, nostalgic longing.
